en.bdb: The pleasure-fruit of the gurmukhs and its grandeur

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਨ ਓੜਕੁ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam arath karoR na oRak jaanai|

en.bdb: Crores of properties such as truth, contentment, pity, dharma, lucre are there but none could know the extremity of that (pleasure-fruit).

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਲਖੂਣਿ ਨ ਪਲੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: chaar padhaarath aakheean hoi lakhoon na pal paravaanai|

en.bdb: Four ideals are said to be and may be they are multiplied by lakhs, even then they do not equal the one moment of pleasure fruit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧੀ ਸਿਧੀ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਲਖ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ridhee sidhee lakh lakh nidh nidhaan lakh til na tulaanai|

en.bdb: Riddhis, Siddhis and lakhs of treasures do not equal its one small fraction.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲਖ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਖ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: dharasan dhirasaT sa(n)jog lakh sabadh surat liv lakh hairaanai|

en.bdb: Seeing the intimacy of Word and the consciousness, many combinations of philosophies and meditations are surprised.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਅਸੰਖ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਲਖਨੇਤ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan simaran asa(n)kh bhagat jugat lakhanet vakhaanai|

en.bdb: Many methods of knowledge, meditation and remembrance are put forth;

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: piram piaalaa sahaj ghar gurmukh sukhafal choj viddaanai|

en.bdb: But reaching the tranquil stage, the pleasure-fruit of the cup of love of the Lord attained by gurmukhs is wondrous.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਲਖ ਮੇਲ ਮਿਲਾਣੈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: mat budh sudh lakh mel milaanai ||18||

en.bdb: At this stage, intellect, wisdom and millions of purities get combined.
